text:
scan-bot: [ALERT] SAST pipeline failed on `main` — scanner couldn't download build artifact: KMS decrypt error (request id: abc123). build:4520. @eng-security please triage

alex: saw this, looks like the scanner service account lost decrypt perms after an RBAC change.

mia: @alex which RBAC change? I just approved group binding cleanup yesterday afternoon.

alex: PR 1223 removed a transitive binding. It looks like `ci-scanners` lost `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` via that PR.

david: can we confirm in audit logs before we roll anything back? need principal + timestamp to correlate.

alex: checked Cloud Audit logs: principal `serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` -> permissionDenied on `cryptoKeys/decrypt` at 2026-03-20T14:02:11Z. quick query I used: `gcloud logging read \"protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\\\"scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\\\" AND protoPayload.status.code=7\" --limit 5`

mia: ok rollback approved from my side. this is blocking merges. any objections?

jen: oncall FYI — please create an incident ticket for audit trail. Reverting the binding is fine short-term but we need follow-ups.

samir: we can also do an ephemeral grant to unblock quickly while we investigate. I'll provision one and re-run the pipeline.

samir: ran: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/artifacts --member=serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` (added ephemeral).

scan-bot: [INFO] Re-run started (build 4521) by samir.

alex: pipeline passed on re-run. good.

alex: longer term we should add better telemetry: attach a `correlation_id` from the CI job to the KMS request metadata so logs show the CI job id. makes triage much faster. Also scanner should classify this as `authz` error and give a clear remediation link in GH status.

mia: agree. filing a follow-up for telemetry + clearer scanner error handling.

jen: I'll own the follow-up. creating SEC ticket and updating runbook with rollback + ephemeral grant steps.

jen: created SEC-2026: "scanner KMS authz hard-fail — telemetry + remediation" https://issues.redwood.ai/SEC-2026

david: recommend runbook update include the exact audit log query + example `gcloud` commands to grant/revoke ephemeral perms and a recommended TTL pattern.

jen: adding those. plan: 1) runbook update, 2) scanner change to detect `permissionDenied` and surface remediation, 3) telemetry enrichment (correlation_id in KMS logs), 4) CI policy check to prevent RBAC removals without owning teams signoff.

alex: small implementation note: scanner retry should wait on exponential backoff a couple times — often RBAC changes propagate but we shouldn't hang merges indefinitely. also include clear GH status on failure.

mia: also let's reduce blast radius: when we re-add binding, use IAM conditions to scope it to `serviceAccount:scanner@...` and `resource.name` for that key; and set a short TTL for ephemeral grants where possible.

samir: will create an IAM change with condition and short TTL for the key binding, and follow up with a script to automate ephemeral grants for oncall use.

jen: thanks — I'll merge runbook edits and own SEC-2026 until scanner PR lands. I'll ping again once doc + PRs are in. :tada:

alex: one last ask — add a link to the KMS audit dashboard to the runbook (query + example chart) so oncall can see failed decrypts in the last 30m.

jen: good idea, added to the ticket. closing this thread once runbook PR is merged.
